notablePrerequisites:
"Dragon" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
You have enough mana to pay for commnader tax, if applicable.
description:
Cast Rograkh either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {0} plus commnander tax, if applicable.
When Rograkh enters the battlefield, Lathliss and Cloudstone Curio triggers.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Rograkh from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
